      Pricing frequently asked questions
      

	

		
			How do the different Neo4j AuraDB plans compare?
			
				
					Free: Start with a free plan to learn and explore graph data.
					Professional: Build high-performance applications with a production-ready cloud database.
					Business Critical: Ideal for mission-critical applications requiring a highly available database, robust enterprise controls, and 24/7 support. Perfect for running production workloads in a fully managed, secure, and flexible environment where uninterrupted access and security are essential.
					Virtual Dedicated Cloud: Ideal for customers needing highly customized, dedicated infrastructure with Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) and specific networking requirements. It offers a highly available database, robust security controls, and premium 24/7 support.
				
				For more details on AuraDB capabilities, visit Neo4j AuraDB.
			
		

		
			How does Neo4j AuraDB Professional differ from the free plan?
			
				The free plan places limits on the number of nodes and relationships. It is suitable for small projects, learning, and prototyping. In contrast, AuraDB Professional offers enhanced performance and best-effort support, making it ideal for building high-performance, production-ready applications.
			
		

		
			Is there a free trial for the paid plans?
			
				Neo4j provides free trials on the AuraDB Professional tier as part of the paid plans, allowing users to explore the features and benefits before committing. The AuraDB Professional trial is available only in certain geographies for now. Contact sales@neo4j.com or sign up directly.
			
		

		
			Can you use AuraDB on multiple cloud providers and marketplaces?
			
				AuraDB is available on AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud. You can deploy AuraDB in over 60 global cloud regions. You can easily access and deploy AuraDB Professional through the following marketplaces:

				
			
		

		
			What are the differences between Neo4j graph analytics product offerings?
			
				Neo4j offers a few different product offerings to provide the 65+ algorithms that accomplish tasks like community detection, node similarity, and centrality.
				
					Neo4j Aura Graph Analytics is a fully managed advanced analytics offering that provides graph algorithms available in both a PAYG and prepaid model and for use.
					Neo4j AuraDS is a fully managed advanced analytics offering that includes a dedicated graph database and the graph algorithms running in the same deployment (storage and compute together).
					Neo4j Graph Data Science is a self-managed advanced analytics offering that users deploy and manage themselves. It requires a Neo4j graph database and runs on and uses the same compute resources as the graph database. 
					Neo4j Graph Analytics for Snowflake is a fully managed advanced analytics offering only available in the Snowflake Marketplace in a PAYG model. Deployed in your Snowflake environment, it enables users to run graph algorithms on demand using data in tables stored in Snowflake. See pricing information on Snowflake Marketplace.
